Synthesize a Multi-Resolution DICOM WSI Pyramid for Testing

Source: R/wsi.R
dicom_synthesize_wsi.Rd

Generates a synthetic tiled Whole Slide Imaging (WSI) directory hierarchy with real DICOM Part 10 tile files and level metadata supporting both "TILED_FULL" and "TILED_SPARSE" dimension organizations.

Usage

dicom_synthesize_wsi(
  out_dir = tempfile("wsi_"),
  base_dims = c(64L, 64L),
  tile_dims = c(16L, 16L),
  levels = 2L,
  organization = c("TILED_FULL", "TILED_SPARSE")
)

Arguments

out_dir

Output directory path.

base_dims

Base (Level 1) pixel matrix dimensions c(rows, cols).

tile_dims

Tile dimensions c(tile_rows, tile_cols).

levels

Number of pyramid levels to synthesize (default 2L).

organization

Either "TILED_FULL" or "TILED_SPARSE".

Value

A list with out_dir, levels, and level_arrays (ground-truth 2D numeric matrices per level).
